The domain of $\operatorname{arcsin}⁡(x)$ is $x\in [-1,1].$  

Now, substituting $x=\frac{\sqrt{3}}{2}$ directly into the limit, we have

$$
\begin{aligned}{lim}_{x\to \,\sqrt{3}/2}\operatorname{tan}⁡(\frac{3}{4}\operatorname{arcsin}⁡(x)) & =\operatorname{tan}⁡(\frac{3}{4}\operatorname{arcsin}⁡(\frac{\sqrt{3}}{2})) \\  & =\operatorname{tan}⁡(\frac{3}{4}\cdot \frac{\pi }{3}) \\  & =\operatorname{tan}⁡(\frac{\pi }{4}) \\  & =1.\end{aligned}
$$
